name: 1PhoneMirror
description: 1PhoneMirror is a Windows-based screen-mirroring receiver designed for Intune admins to capture consistent, framed mobile-device screens for documentation and training. It supports iOS/macOS AirPlay with optional PIN, Android wireless debugging via bundled adb/scrcpy, and experimental Miracast, delivering one-click screenshots or MP4/GIF recordings inside a device frame. Multiple devices can stay paired and be switched from a bottom bezel, with no app installations on phones.
author: Simon Skotheimsvik

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase contains telemetry that exfiltrates usage data (including user agent and country) and build-time dependency actions that pull tools from remote sources. A notable security hardening issue is the use of an http timestamp URL for code signing. While the tooling and telemetry are expected in enterprise workflows, enforcing data minimization, secure timestamping, and tighter control over external dependencies will improve the security posture without impeding legitimate admin workflows.

noRemoteExecution.reason: Code signing timestamp uses an http URL (http://timestamp.digicert.com). This introduces potential MITM risk for timestamp tokens, which could affect the validity of code signing. Recommend switching to https and/or using a trusted, validated timestamp source.
